name: 07024 · Fort Lee, NJ
findings: ZIP 07024 (Fort Lee) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07024 (Fort Lee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07024 (Fort Lee) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
